parts.name: body_ford_transit
sources: The front door: its seam at 1.27 m behind the front axle and its window from x 0.10 to 1.16 m (the photos and renders of dealers, transit_passenger notes). Its front edge over the arch of the wheel and its bottom at 0.42 m: by eye from the same photos.
The sliding door: 1300 by 1601 mm (Ford, Body Builders Layout Book 2022), from 1.3 m behind the front axle; the door is from 0.42 to 2.36 m (the photos of dealers).

The rear doors: from the lamps at the back (0.095 m in from the side) to the middle, from 0.71 m (over the bumper) to 0.05 m over the opening, which is 1887 mm (high roof) or 1648 mm (medium roof) high from the floor (Ford, Body Builders Layout Book 2022; the photos of dealers).

parts.name: cab_transit
sources: The dash and the steering wheel: by eye from the photos of the inside of a 2026 Transit passenger van (https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/fenton-mi/new-2026-ford-transit-350-xl-passenger-van-25226733).

parts.name: details_transit
sources: The vents of the hood and the rail of the sliding door at 1.45 m: from the photos of dealers.

parts.name: engine_bay_transit
sources: The air box, the coolant reservoir, the fuse box and the brake reservoir: from the photos of the bay of a 2022 Transit.

parts.name: engine_ford_3_5_v6
sources: The 3.5 L V6 of the Transit, along the van: its size and its belt by eye, from photos of the bay.

parts.name: front_door_panel
sources: The front door: its seam at 1.27 m behind the front axle and its window from x 0.10 to 1.16 m (the photos and renders of dealers, transit_passenger notes). Its front edge over the arch of the wheel and its bottom at 0.42 m: by eye from the same photos.

parts.name: grille_transit
sources: The grille: a hexagon 1.2 m wide at its top and 0.95 m at its bottom, from 0.66 to 1.15 m, with the oval in its upper middle (the photos of dealers).

parts.name: inside_ford_transit
sources: The floor of the cargo area at 0.73 m (the model); the floor of the cab, the wells of the wheels and the pillar behind the front door: by eye from the photos of the van with the doors open.

parts.name: radiator_transit
sources: A radiator of about 1.1 by 0.5 m with its fan shroud: by eye.

parts.name: rear_door_panel
sources: The rear doors: from the lamps at the back (0.095 m in from the side) to the middle, from 0.71 m (over the bumper) to 0.05 m over the opening, which is 1887 mm (high roof) or 1648 mm (medium roof) high from the floor (Ford, Body Builders Layout Book 2022; the photos of dealers).

parts.name: sliding_door_panel
sources: The sliding door: 1300 by 1601 mm (Ford, Body Builders Layout Book 2022), from 1.3 m behind the front axle; the door is from 0.42 to 2.36 m (the photos of dealers).

parts.name: tire_235_65R16
sources: ETRTO 235/65R16: width 235 mm, side 153 mm, rim 406.4 mm.

parts.name: trim_ford_transit
sources: The black plastic of the Transit, from the photos of dealers: the front bumper from 0.29 to 0.76 m, the back bumper to 0.7 m and the lamps at the back from 0.7 to 1.355 m (the passenger van from the back: https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/starke-fl/new-2026-ford-transit-350-xl-passenger-van-23229223), the band from 0.5 to 0.78 m and the edge under 0.41 m between the wheels.
